simple.meaning: דָּא (dâʼ) is a Hebrew word meaning “this.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: דָּא (H1668) appears 6 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Daniel 4:27, with occurrences in Daniel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דָּא (H1668) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in דָּא (H1668) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: דָּא (dâʼ) / H1668 is traced through Daniel 4:27, Daniel 5:6, Daniel 7:3, Daniel 7:8 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H1668. da דָּא demonstrative pronoun feminine this (= Biblical Hebrew זֹה : Zinjirli Têma, Cappadocian, Egyptian Aramaic זא , Nabataean דא , Palmyrene דה (Lzb 264: Eph. i. 323 Cooke 26 ), דא ᵑ7 : see further below Biblical Hebrew זֶה . The corresponding masculine is דְּנָה ); — this , Dan 4:27 רַבְּתָא בַּבֶל דָיא הֲלָא , 5:6 נָ֧קְשָׁן לְדָא דָּא one striking against another , similarly 7:3 (compare זֶה 1b ), 7:8 בְקַרְנָאדָֿא .
